title: Slovakian Skillet Pancakes
description: Delicious Slovakian-style pancakes made with sunflower seeds and a hint of sour milk. Perfect for a weekend breakfast.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sunflower seeds, and sugar.
In a separate bowl, whisk together lacto milk, sour milk, and eggs.
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
Heat a large skillet over medium heat.
Drop the batter by 1/4 cupfuls onto the skillet.
Cook for 2-3 minutes, until bubbles appear on the surface.
Flip the pancakes and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
Serve hot with melted butter and a sprinkle of sunflower seeds.
